address: 13, Lane 81, Section 2, Yongfu Road, West Central, Tainan, Taiwan
bio: The owner-chef received classic French training and worked for a time in Japan. With this joint in the artsy enclave known as Snail Alley, he champions a unique take on "French-influenced Nippon cuisine". The single set menu changes once a month, with a choice of main from two or three options. Instead of red and white, the wine list features an array of sake from Kyushu, which the owner-chef finds matching his culinary style to a tee.
